gold_rationale: Under RBI-KYC-Master-Direction-2016 Section 3(a)(iv)(d) (version 2018-07-12) the limit is 15 percent or more. TPTR07 applies exactly that limit and comparison (TPTR07.cbl line 30), so it conforms to this version of the clause.
